title: R1: Put the function lessons back (c1/06-09: In order, Multiply, Make your own card, Use it again) (M)
description:
Effort: M (content, not engine). Do first.

**Problem.** The throughline (functions, f(x) from Algebra 2) is missing; the student makes nothing.
**Evidence.** course-1-design.md lines 43-46 plan 'In order', 'Multiply', 'Make your own card' (f(x) = x squared plus 1, 50 for 7), 'Use it again'; lessons/c1 has none; the builder and Save as card exist (docs/ui-design.md); /learn/gallery says 'Nothing here yet' after eight lessons.
**Change.** Author four lessons as c1/06-09 using the existing builder, Save as card and Gallery; move flip, lamps and fields after them (design line 50 order). Save the custom card to the Gallery. Reach Make your own card by lesson 8 at the latest.
**Acceptance (Gherkin-able).**
- Given the path, when the catalog loads, then lessons 6-9 are In order, Multiply, Make your own card, Use it again.
- When the student finishes Make your own card, then the card is in the Gallery.
- Given no Show me, when asked 'What does your card give for 3?' and 'Make a card for 2x + 1', then both are answered.
Note: engine gaps G2/G3 (SIE-8d128f, SIE-4174f5) widen this later; first version uses what exists.
